notes.title: Demo Update 01
notes.notes: [h1]We Updated the Demo![/h1][p]A bit delayed, but we published the first update for the demo today! [/p][p]It's a small download (roughly 150mb). [/p][p]Here's what's changed:[/p][list][*][p]Cut the amount of battery drained per second while using the flashlight in half. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the Pause menu didn't function properly after interacting with the workbench[/p][/*][*][p]Added QoL tips for using interior lights when possible and that it's currently [i]expected[/i] for the wheel to freeze during the loading screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes were made based upon player feedback. [b]Do keep the feedback coming[/b]! We'll continue to adjust the demo based upon your experiences and it'll also help us make the full game even better.[/p][h2]We appreciate you.[/h2][h3]Tell your friends about the game. We need your help getting the word out![/h3][p]Immortal, Inc.[/p][p](Justin)[/p]
